# Copilot Instructions

- Read and enforce [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the single source of truth for all rules, localization (`it`, `de`, `fr`, `en`), quality gates, and `dev`-only Git workflow.
- Copilot override: keep edits scoped to docs and reusable `.github/workflows/*.yml` files, emit focused diffs, and never suggest PR creation or pushes to `main`.
